floorPlans.label: Emaar: Elva complete townhouse plans
floorPlans.introduction: Explore Elva’s Ravine and Nash three and four bedroom layouts. Published built-up area includes suite, garage and balcony or terrace components. Some source tables and unit labels are inconsistent; confirm the final unit reference and area with Emaar.
floorPlans.note: Source sheet 2 prints 2,704.81 sq ft although its component rows total 2,709.81 sq ft. Sheet 5 labels a four-bedroom unit TH03 while its key plan highlights TH04. Published totals and complete sheets are retained without guessing corrections. Confirm the selected unit, dimensions and sale inclusions.
